_: RATCHET BASELINES. These numbers may only go DOWN.
preflight-static.sh fails when a count exceeds its baseline, and lowers the baseline in place
when a count improves — so today's number becomes tomorrow's ceiling and the debt cannot
quietly grow back. Raising a number by hand is an operator decision, not a fix.
